elements.requirement: An employer must remunerate a person who qualifies for the national minimum wage in respect of that person's work in any pay reference period at a rate not less than the national minimum wage.
elements.quote: shall be remunerated by his employer in respect of his work in any pay reference period at a rate which is not less than the national minimum wage

elements.requirement: An individual qualifies for the national minimum wage only if that individual is a worker.
An individual qualifies for the national minimum wage only if that individual is working, or ordinarily works, in the United Kingdom under their contract.
elements.quote: is working, or ordinarily works, in the United Kingdom under his contract

elements.requirement: An individual qualifies for the national minimum wage only if that individual has ceased to be of compulsory school age.
elements.quote: has ceased to be of compulsory school age

elements.requirement: The national minimum wage must be such single hourly rate as the Secretary of State may prescribe from time to time.
elements.quote: shall be such single hourly rate as the Secretary of State may from time to time prescribe

elements.requirement: A pay reference period for the purposes of the Act is defined as such period as the Secretary of State may prescribe for that purpose.
elements.quote: “pay reference period” is such period as the Secretary of State may prescribe for the purpose

elements.requirement: The rules and definitions in subsections (1) to (4) of section 1 are subject to the subsequent provisions of the Act.
elements.quote: Subsections (1) to (4) above are subject to the following provisions of this Act
